title: feat(design_snapshots): immutable LTB design snapshot pinned to an unverified CNC job
intent: Add an immutable ltb_design_snapshot 1.0 that copies the current project serializer output and pins it to a caller-supplied CNC-Production-Shop job_id marked UNVERIFIED_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE. Do not change project save, add a route, or grant CAM or manufacturing authority.
behavior_change: New unrouted library app/design_snapshots. Project save bytes are unchanged. New writes are immutable JSON files in a caller-supplied directory. The CNC job reference cannot be marked verified.

diff_articulation.what_changed: New domain package app/design_snapshots copies serialize_design_state output into an immutable file with a collision-safe snapshot id, an unverified CNC job reference, and sha256 digests of the design payload and the snapshot. Project save, routers, and CNC-Production-Shop are not modified.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: SHOP-OPERATING-LOOP-RECOVERY-001 left MVS S4 unbuilt: LTB overwrites Project.data and has no immutable design revision. PR #464 records shop operations and does not pin a design. Rosette and art snapshots are different products.

commands_run: cd services/api && python -m pytest tests/design_snapshots tests/shop_operations tests/test_analyzer_project_observation.py tests/projects/test_project_artifact_association.py tests/physical_engineering/test_evidence_artifact_v1.py tests/test_openapi.py -q --no-cov
